user.description: Select location to use for weather forecasting

user.title: Add surface
user.description:
A surface is a plane, described by how it is tilted and which way it faces. Tilt is measured from horizontal: 0° is a flat roof, 90° a wall. Azimuth is compass degrees: 0° north, 90° east, 180° south, 270° west, matching the sun entity.

Terrain, overhangs and neighbouring buildings are not modelled here — mask the direct beam sensor for those.

data_description.tilt: 0° for a horizontal surface, 90° for a vertical one.
data_description.azimuth: The direction the surface faces, in compass degrees.
data_description.albedo: Fraction of light reflected by the ground in front of the surface. 0.2 suits most ground; raise it for snow.
